review_evidence: README describes ImpLab as a playground for programming-language modeling, with debugger tooling built around a toy imperative language.

ImpLab/Lang/Ast.lean defines the object-language operators, statements, functions, globals and programs; ImpLab/Lang/Eval.lean gives environments/heaps and an explicit one-step transition `step`, while Trace.lean constructs execution traces.

Although the 24 Lean files contain no theorem declarations, these language definitions and operational-semantics constructions are primary formal specifications under FILTER-001, so whole-source retirement would not be lossless.
summary: Reviewed imp-lab; retain its explicit toy-language syntax, small-step evaluator, execution traces, and teaching semantics.
